description: This bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy (instilled) for two language models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, across three conditions: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training. The horizontal axis presents the two model types, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, in order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled)”, ranges from 0.00 to 0.75 and uses a linear scale. Each model type is represented by a group of three adjacent bars: a grey bar for the Control condition, a light blue bar for the Before Introspection Training condition, and a dark purple bar for the After Introspection Training condition. For GPT-4o, the Control bar reaches approximately 0.15, the Before Training bar reaches approximately 0.60, and the After Training bar reaches approximately 0.80. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control bar reaches approximately 0.05, the Before Training bar reaches approximately 0.70, and the After Training bar reaches approximately 0.90. Each bar is accompanied by a vertical error bar indicating variability. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model types on the horizontal axis.
